title: Sindhu Flags Gruelling Asian Games Schedule After Quarterfinal Exit
indian_angle: India's top female shuttler PV Sindhu shares her experience and challenges faced during her recent Asian Games campaign.
summary: PV Sindhu expressed concerns over the demanding schedule at the Asian Games, where she played three singles matches in 18 hours, contributing to her quarterfinal exit.

title: National Coaching Camp Begins for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This camp at NCE Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has commenced a national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, to prepare players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The successful completion of this advanced coaching course will enhance the quality of badminton coaching across India.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course, held from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, in NCE Guwahati and Raipur, has concluded, aiming to upskill Indian badminton coaches.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp focuses on preparing India's promising U17 and U15 junior players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati.

title: India's Best to Face Top International Stars at Women's Indian Open

summary: The Women's Indian Open is set to host a strong field, with India's best shuttlers preparing to challenge top international stars.
